ActionIcons.hint: Allow character owners to customize images on Actions tab rows. Reload to apply.
ActionIcons.title: Customize action icon
ActionIcons.instructions: Recommended: square (1:1), 128 × 128 pixels. Near-square images stretch to fit. Wider or taller images get transparent padding. Large images are downscaled.
ActionIcons.uploadHint: Choose an image from a library, or open a writable folder in the picker, upload your image, and select it.
ActionIcons.denied: You need permission to edit this item.
ActionIcons.browseDenied: Ask your GM for file browsing permission to choose an image.
ActionIcons.failed: Could not change this icon. Check image access, file format, and permissions.
